ונתן לי באמצע התפילה שהתפללתי הביא לי, נתן לי בסתר, כדי שלא ירגישו שהוא נתן לי אז אני הייתי ילד עני והיה לי רצון, רצון חזק שיהיה לי סידור

שיהיה בו חצות ותהלים ומעמדות וכל, וכל שאר התפילות, יש סידור כזה

אז לקחתי את המטבעות האלו, שהאיש הזה נתן לי, ונתן לי בכל פעם

וקיבצתי ונתתי, לא נתתי לאבא, וקניתי בזה ספר, סידור שיש בו כל מיני תפילות שבעולם

חצות ותהלים ומעמדות וכל.. והרבה תפילות

וזה היה אצלי כמו הון רב, זה הסידור היה חשוב אצלי

על כל פנים אני אקצר עד.. לא..

[שום דבר שייקח שנה לא אכפת לי]

{..}

[לא בוער לאף אחד, רבי ישראל]

{..}

[אם עושים צריך לעשות עבודה מושלמת]

כן, נו, אני, אני אתחיל לספר

[לא]

בזמן

[לא, אל תמשיך, אל, לא בוער לאף אחד, זה לא רצים, יש זמן]

נו, זה כבר, כבר כלול בהדיבורים האלו כבר כלול כמעט הכל

[עוד לא]

אני היה לי רצונות חזקים והיה לי מלחמות כבדות וחיפשתי מקום הצלה, ולא..

[ואחרי שקנית את הסידור הזה?]

אחרי

[עשית חצות?]

שקניתי הסידור הזה

לא בכל לילה, אבל היה לי רצונות חזקים לקום בחצות לילה ולקרוא בתהלים

לפעמים קמתי, אבל אני זוכר שבטבריה היה אויר חם מאד
segments.en:
Then I found favor in his eyes.

[What was his name?]

Rav Yaakov Kasir.

[Rav Yaakov Kasir.]

Yaakov Kasir—that was the family name, Kasir.

He was a great miser, but he gave to me each time, almost every day; he gave me a coin, a coin...

In those days it was an important, important coin.

And he gave it to me in the middle of the prayer while I was praying—he brought it to me, gave it to me secretly, so that they would not notice that he had given it to me. Then I was a poor child, and I had a desire, a strong desire, to have a siddur

that contained Chatzos and Tehillim and Maamados and all, and all the other prayers. There is such a siddur.

But such a siddur cost, cost a great deal of money, and I had no money.

So I took those coins that this man gave me, and he gave me each time,

and I gathered them and gave them, did not give them to Father, and with them I bought a book, a siddur containing all kinds of prayers in the world:

Chatzos and Tehillim and Maamados and all... and many prayers.

And it was like great wealth to me; this siddur was precious to me.

At any rate, I will shorten until... no...

[Anything that takes a year—I do not mind.]

{..}

[It is not urgent for anyone, Rebbe Yisroel.]

{..}

[If one does it, one must do perfect work.]

Yes, nu, I, I will begin to tell.

[No.]

At the time...

[No, do not continue. Do not—it is not urgent for anyone; this is not a race. There is time.]

Nu, this is already, already included in these words; almost everything is already included.

[Not yet.]

I had strong desires, and I had heavy battles, and I searched for a place of salvation, and did not...

[And after you bought this siddur?]

After...

[Did you perform Chatzos?]

that I bought this siddur...

Not every night, but I had strong desires to rise at midnight for Chatzos and recite Tehillim.

Sometimes I rose, but I remember that in Teveria the air was very hot.

segments.en:
And all... and the heat was so intense during the day that at night it was also very hot.

For the stones became heated by the sun, and there was very great heat.

And the entire city slept on the rooftops, on the roof, and I also, also did.

But I rose several hours before, before the light of dawn.

And I descended from the roof into the house, and our house had no windows, no, no...

It was like a cave, and I descended from the roof...
